questions.stem:
다음 내용이 본문의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.

"Su Blackwell은 미술대학 졸업 후 태국에서 여행하던 중 중고 서적을 발견하고 종이 예술에 관심을 갖게 되었다."

det.ref: [원문] After graduating → traveled to Thailand → came across a used book → interested in the way paper was used in art. 모든 세부 사항 일치.
det.correct: T: 졸업 후 ✓ 태국 여행 ✓ 중고 서적 발견 ✓ 종이 예술 관심 ✓ → 정답 ✅ F: 불일치 부분 없음 ❌
det.tip: 🔑 come across ≈ find by chance(우연히 발견하다). by accident ≈ accidentally.

questions.passage: How do we open ourselves up to new possibilities? One of the ways to do this is to connect things that look separate. This can be incredibly pleasing as it helps us to see the world in a different light and gain a greater appreciation for the interrelation of all things.
questions.stem:
다음 글을 읽고, 주어진 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하시오.

[조건] 주어진 단어를 활용하여 빈칸을 완성할 것 / 4단어로 쓸 것
[보기] connect / separate / look

One of the ways to open ourselves up to new possibilities is to ____________.

det.ref: [원문] connect things that look separate [해석] 분리되어 보이는 것들을 연결하다. 주어진 단어 connect, separate, look을 모두 활용하여 4단어 구성.
det.correct: 모범답안: connect things that look separate. connect(연결하다) + things(것들) + that look(~처럼 보이는) + separate(분리된). 관계대명사 that이 things를 수식.
det.tip: 🔑 look + 형용사 = ~하게 보이다(2형식 감각동사). that = 주격 관계대명사로 things 수식.

questions.passage: He completed the image with a few lines, took a picture and shared it on the Internet. The reactions were so positive that he challenged himself to make one shadow image every day.
questions.stem:

[보기] reaction / so / positive / challenge

The ____________ to make one shadow image every day.

det.ref: [원문] The reactions were so positive that he challenged himself to make one shadow image every day. so ~ that 구문: 너무 ~해서 ...하다.
det.correct: 모범답안: reactions were so positive that he challenged himself. reaction → reactions(복수), so ~ that 구문, challenge → challenged(과거) + himself(재귀대명사).
det.tip: 🔑 so + 형/부 + that + S + V = 너무 ~해서 ...하다. challenge oneself to-v = 자신에게 ~하도록 도전하다.
